definition_zh: 苗条的；微薄的；减肥
definition_en: thin in an attractive way, small in amount, or to try to become thinner
core_image: 一条合身的细腰长裙挂在衣架上
scene: 她每天游泳，一直保持着苗条的身材。She stays slim by swimming every day.
sceneCN: 这里 slim 是「苗条的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她每天游泳，一直保持着苗条的身材。

senses.title: Attractively thin
senses.definition: thin in a healthy and attractive way
senses.definitionCN: 瘦得健康而好看
senses.example: She stays slim by swimming every day.
senses.exampleCN: 她每天游泳，一直保持着苗条的身材。
senses.why: This is the everyday body sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是日常形容身材的义项。

senses.title: Small in amount
senses.definition: small in amount or unlikely to happen
senses.definitionCN: 数量很少，或发生的可能性很小
senses.example: There is a slim chance of rain tonight.
senses.exampleCN: 今晚下雨的机会很渺茫。
senses.why: The idea of thinness extends to amounts.
senses.whyCN: 「瘦」的概念延伸到数量上。

senses.title: Try to lose weight
senses.definition: to try to become thinner, often by eating less
senses.definitionCN: 试图变瘦，常通过少吃
senses.example: He is slimming for the summer.
senses.why: The adjective became a verb of dieting.
senses.whyCN: 形容词转化为表示节食的动词。

intro.en: Slim appeared in English in the seventeenth century, and its origin is uncertain.
intro.cn: slim 在十七世纪出现于英语，来源并不确定。

items.en: The word appeared in the seventeenth century.
items.cn: 这个词在十七世纪出现。

abstract.en: A slim hope is still a hope.

abstract.en: Thin margins leave little room for error.
abstract.cn: 微薄的余量几乎没有犯错空间。

abstract.en: The body can be slim, but the mind should never be narrow.

definition_zh: 滑倒；纸条；差错；悄悄移动
definition_en: to slide by accident, a small piece of paper, a small mistake, or to move quietly
core_image: 一只脚踩到湿地板，整个人向后滑
scene: 他在湿滑的地板上滑倒了。He slipped on the wet floor.
sceneCN: 这里 slip 是「滑倒」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他在湿滑的地板上滑倒了。

senses.title: Slide by accident
senses.definition: to slide accidentally and lose your balance
senses.definitionCN: 意外滑动并失去平衡
senses.example: He slipped on the wet floor.
senses.exampleCN: 他在湿滑的地板上滑倒了。
senses.why: This is the physical falling sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是身体滑倒的义项。

senses.title: Small piece of paper
senses.definition: a small piece of paper used for writing
senses.definitionCN: 用来写字的小片纸
senses.example: She wrote her number on a slip of paper.
senses.why: A thin strip of paper slips easily.
senses.whyCN: 薄纸条容易滑落，因此得名。

senses.title: Small mistake
senses.definition: a small careless mistake
senses.definitionCN: 粗心造成的小错误
senses.example: One slip in the report cost us the deal.
senses.exampleCN: 报告中的一处差错让我们失去了这笔交易。
senses.why: A mental slip is like a physical one.
senses.whyCN: 思维上的失误就像身体滑了一下。

senses.title: Move quietly
senses.definition: to move somewhere quickly and quietly
senses.definitionCN: 快速而安静地移动到某处
senses.example: She slipped out of the room.
senses.why: The word pictures a smooth, unnoticed move.
senses.whyCN: 这个词描绘不被注意的平滑移动。

definition_zh: 滑的；狡猾的；难以捉摸的
definition_en: difficult to hold or walk on because it is smooth or wet, or hard to trust
core_image: 雨后湿滑的石阶泛着水光
scene: 雨后的石阶很滑，走时要小心。The stone steps are slippery after the rain.
sceneCN: 这里 slippery 是「滑的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：雨后的石阶很滑，走时要小心。

senses.title: Hard to stand on
senses.definition: smooth or wet so that feet or hands can slide
senses.definitionCN: 光滑或潮湿，使脚或手容易滑动
senses.example: The stone steps are slippery after the rain.

senses.title: Hard to trust

senses.title: Hard to pin down

senses.whyCN: 连观念也会从我们手中滑走。

normalIntro.en: Smell is what the nose receives and what the nose does.

normal.en: A sweet smell came from the kitchen.
I can smell the coffee from here.

normal.en: The kitchen smells of fresh bread.

normal.en: Dogs have a strong sense of smell.
The flowers smell wonderful at night.
normal.cn: 这些花在夜里闻起来很香。

abstract.en: Smell remembers what the eyes forget.

abstract.en: A familiar smell can open an old room in the mind.

abstract.en: Some truths are smelled before they are spoken.

examples.en: A sweet smell came from the kitchen.
I can smell the coffee from here.

core.en: What the nose can notice or send out.

branches.en: Bread sends a sweet odour.

branches.en: A room carries its own scent.

intro.en: Smell builds words for odours and the act of sniffing.

The smelly bin was emptied.

definition_zh: 微笑；笑容；微笑着表示
definition_en: a happy expression with the corners of the mouth turned up, or to make such an expression
core_image: 嘴角上扬的一张温暖笑脸
scene: 她对我露出温暖的微笑。She gave me a warm smile.
sceneCN: 这里 smile 是「微笑」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她对我露出温暖的微笑。

senses.title: A happy expression
senses.definition: an expression of pleasure in which the corners of the mouth turn up
senses.definitionCN: 嘴角上扬、表示愉快的表情
senses.example: She gave me a warm smile.
senses.exampleCN: 她对我露出温暖的微笑。
senses.why: This is the noun sense of the expression.
senses.whyCN: 这是表示表情的名词义项。

senses.title: To make a smile
senses.definition: to make a happy expression with the mouth
senses.definitionCN: 用嘴做出愉快的表情
senses.example: He smiled at the good news.
senses.why: The noun became a verb of acting.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为表示动作的动词。

senses.title: Show by smiling
senses.definition: to express something by means of a smile
senses.definitionCN: 通过微笑来表达某事
senses.example: She smiled her agreement.
senses.why: A smile can carry a whole message.
senses.whyCN: 一个微笑能承载完整的信息。

intro.en: Smile came into English from a Germanic source.
intro.cn: smile 从日耳曼语来源进入英语。

items.en: The word entered English as smile.
items.cn: 这个词以 smile 进入英语。

items.en: It named both the act and the look.
A smile became a sign of welcome.
To smile on something can mean to approve.
items.cn: smile on 某事可以表示赞许。

note.en: Smile is compared with look-alike words and words for happy expressions.
note.cn: 把 smile 与形近词以及表示愉快表情的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: A smile is a message the mouth can send without words.
normalIntro.cn: 微笑是嘴不用说话就能发出的信息。

normal.en: She gave me a warm smile.
normal.cn: 她对我露出温暖的微笑。

normal.en: He smiled at the good news.
She smiled her agreement.
The child smiled back at the nurse.
He greeted us with a smile.

abstract.en: A smile is the cheapest gift that costs the most to fake.
abstract.cn: 微笑是最便宜的礼物，却最难假装。

abstract.en: Some smiles are doors, and some are walls.
abstract.cn: 有些微笑是门，有些是墙。

abstract.en: The face can speak before the voice begins.
abstract.cn: 在声音开始之前，脸已经说话了。

examples.en: She gave me a warm smile.
examples.cn: 她对我露出温暖的微笑。

examples.en: He smiled at the good news.
She smiled her agreement.

dict_mnemonic.text: smile 与 small、smell、mile 形近；smile at 是「对……微笑」，smile back 是「回以微笑」。

root: 经中古英语来自日耳曼语，核心义「嘴角上扬的愉快表情」。

sensesIntro.en: Smile is a happy expression, the act of making one, or expressing something with it.
sensesIntro.cn: smile 指愉快表情、做出该表情的动作，或借它表达某事。

core.en: Pleasure shown at the corners of the mouth.
core.cn: 在嘴角显露的愉悦。

branches.en: The mouth curves upward.
The face answers good news.
Agreement arrives as a smile.
The look and the act are one.
A smile can greet and agree at once.
branches.cn: 一个微笑能同时问候并表示同意。

intro.en: Smile builds words for expressions and friendly looks.
intro.cn: smile 构成表示表情和友善神态的词。

latinIntro.en: Smile is Germanic in origin, not Latin.
latinIntro.cn: smile 源自日耳曼语，不是拉丁语。

items.example: Her smile lit the room.
The child smiles at everyone.
She smiled at the old photo.
A smiling waiter showed us in.
items.exampleCN: 一位微笑的服务员把我们引进去。

items.example: He is a natural smiler.
She drew a smiley face.
The guard stood unsmiling.
He ended the message with a smiley face.
items.exampleCN: 他用一个笑脸符号结束了消息。

definition_zh: 烟；吸烟；冒烟；熏制
definition_en: the grey gas that rises from a fire, to breathe in tobacco, to give off smoke, or to cure food with smoke
core_image: 一缕灰烟从烟囱里缓缓升起
scene: 烟从烟囱里升起来。Smoke rose from the chimney.
sceneCN: 这里 smoke 是「烟」（第 1 个义项）；句意：烟从烟囱里升起来。

senses.title: Gas from fire
senses.definition: the grey or black gas produced when something burns
senses.definitionCN: 某物燃烧时产生的灰色或黑色气体
senses.example: Smoke rose from the chimney.
senses.why: This is the basic substance sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本物质义项。

senses.title: Breathe in tobacco
senses.definition: to breathe in smoke from a cigarette, pipe, or cigar
senses.definitionCN: 吸入香烟、烟斗或雪茄的烟
senses.example: He smokes a pipe after dinner.
senses.why: The substance became an activity.
senses.whyCN: 这种物质变成了一种活动。

senses.title: Give off smoke
senses.definition: to produce smoke, often because of heat or a fault
senses.definitionCN: 产生烟，常因受热或故障
senses.example: The old engine began to smoke.
senses.why: The noun became a verb of producing it.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为表示产生烟的动词。

senses.title: Cure with smoke
senses.definition: to preserve meat or fish by exposing it to smoke
senses.definitionCN: 通过烟熏来保存肉或鱼
senses.example: They smoke fish over the fire.
senses.why: Smoke preserves food as well as carrying heat.
senses.whyCN: 烟既能带热，也能保存食物。

intro.en: Smoke comes from an Old English word of the same meaning.
intro.cn: smoke 来自一个意思相同的古英语词。

items.en: It named the habit of smoking.
Smoke also means to cure food.

note.en: Smoke is compared with look-alike words and words for haze.
note.cn: 把 smoke 与形近词以及表示雾气或烟气的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Smoke is fire's breath, and also the things people do with it.
normalIntro.cn: smoke 是火的气息，也是人们借它做的事。

normal.en: Smoke rose from the chimney.
He smokes a pipe after dinner.
The old engine began to smoke.
They smoke fish over the fire.
Thick smoke filled the hall.

abstract.en: Smoke is a fire that has let go of its heat.
abstract.cn: 烟是放下了热量的火。

abstract.en: Every habit leaves a smell that others can sense.
abstract.cn: 每个习惯都会留下别人能闻到的气味。

abstract.en: Smoke warns before the flame is seen.
abstract.cn: 在看见火焰之前，烟已经发出警告。

examples.en: Smoke rose from the chimney.
He smokes a pipe after dinner.
The old engine began to smoke.

dict_mnemonic.text: smoke 与 smile、snake 形近；smoke signal 是「烟雾信号」，smoked fish 是「熏鱼」。

root: 由古英语 smoca（烟）演变而来，核心义「燃烧升起的烟气」。

sensesIntro.en: Smoke is fire's gas, the act of smoking, giving off smoke, or curing food.
sensesIntro.cn: smoke 指火产生的烟、吸烟、冒烟，或熏制食物。

core.en: What rises from burning and carries it onward.
core.cn: 从燃烧中升起并传递其信息之物。

branches.en: Grey gas leaves the chimney.
A person breathes in tobacco.
A faulty engine sends out smoke.
Fish is preserved above the fire.
The same smoke can warn or preserve.
branches.cn: 同样的烟能警示也能保存。

intro.en: Smoke builds words for fires, habits, and smoky air.
intro.cn: smoke 构成表示火、习惯和烟雾的词。

latinIntro.en: Smoke is a native English word, not Latin.
latinIntro.cn: smoke 是英语本族词，不是拉丁语。

items.example: The smoke made us cough.

items.meaning: gives off smoke or smokes tobacco
items.example: The fire smokes badly.
We ate smoked salmon.
Smoking is banned here.
He is a heavy smoker.
The room was smoky and warm.
They use smokeless fuel.
This is a smoke-free building.

definition_zh: 光滑的；顺利的；使平滑；变平静
definition_en: having an even surface, happening without problems, to make even, or to become calm
core_image: 一块被打磨得反光的木板
scene: 婴儿的皮肤像丝绸一样光滑。The baby's skin is as smooth as silk.
sceneCN: 这里 smooth 是「光滑的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：婴儿的皮肤像丝绸一样光滑。

senses.title: Even surface
senses.definition: having a surface that is even and not rough
senses.definitionCN: 表面平整而不粗糙
senses.example: The baby's skin is as smooth as silk.
senses.exampleCN: 婴儿的皮肤像丝绸一样光滑。
senses.why: This is the physical texture sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是描述质感的义项。

senses.title: Without problems
senses.definition: happening without difficulties or sudden changes
senses.definitionCN: 没有困难或突变地发生
senses.example: We had a smooth journey home.
senses.exampleCN: 我们回家的旅程很顺利。
senses.why: An even surface suggests an easy path.
senses.whyCN: 平整的表面暗示顺畅的路径。

senses.title: Make even
senses.definition: to make a surface or situation even or calm
senses.definitionCN: 使表面或局面变得平整或平静
senses.example: She smoothed the cloth with her hand.
senses.why: The adjective became a verb of action.
senses.whyCN: 形容词转化为动作动词。

senses.title: Become calm
senses.definition: to become calm or less rough, used of water or feelings
senses.definitionCN: 指水面或情绪变得平静或缓和
senses.example: The sea smoothed after the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 暴风雨后海面平静下来。
senses.why: Rough water and rough feelings both smooth.
senses.whyCN: 汹涌的水和激动的情绪都会平息。

intro.en: Smooth comes from an Old English word meaning free from roughness.
intro.cn: smooth 来自古英语中意为「不粗糙」的词。

items.en: The verb meant to make even.

items.cn: smooth over 意为平息争吵。

note.en: Smooth is compared with look-alike words and words for even surfaces.
note.cn: 把 smooth 与形近词以及表示平整的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Smooth means no roughness, no trouble, and no sudden movement.
normalIntro.cn: smooth 意味没有粗糙、没有麻烦、没有突变。

normal.en: The baby's skin is as smooth as silk.

normal.en: We had a smooth journey home.
normal.cn: 我们回家的旅程很顺利。

normal.en: She smoothed the cloth with her hand.
The sea smoothed after the storm.
normal.cn: 暴风雨后海面平静下来。

abstract.en: Smooth roads are made by those who repair them.
abstract.cn: 平坦的路是修路者铺出来的。

abstract.en: A smooth answer can hide a rough truth.
abstract.cn: 圆滑的回答可能掩盖粗糙的真相。

abstract.en: Patience smooths what force would break.
abstract.cn: 耐心能磨平蛮力会打碎的东西。

examples.en: The baby's skin is as smooth as silk.
examples.cn: 婴儿的皮肤像丝绸一样光滑。

examples.en: We had a smooth journey home.
examples.cn: 我们回家的旅程很顺利。

examples.en: The sea smoothed after the storm.
examples.cn: 暴风雨后海面平静下来。

sensesIntro.en: Smooth means even, problem-free, to make even, or to become calm.
sensesIntro.cn: smooth 指平滑、顺利、使平整，或变平静。

core.en: Free from roughness or trouble.
core.cn: 没有粗糙或阻碍。

branches.en: Silk has no rough edge.
A trip passes without trouble.
A hand presses the cloth flat.
The sea settles after wind.
Texture and mood share the same calm.
branches.cn: 质感与情绪共享同一种平静。

intro.en: Smooth builds words for texture, motion, and calm.
intro.cn: smooth 构成表示质感、运动和平静的词。

items.example: The smooth-faced boy looked young.
items.exampleCN: 那个面容光洁的男孩看起来很年轻。

definition_zh: 顺利地；平稳地；流畅地
definition_en: without problems, in a steady way, or in a flowing way
core_image: 列车沿着轨道平稳地驶过
scene: 会议进行得很顺利。The meeting went smoothly.

senses.title: Without problems
senses.definition: without difficulties or delays
senses.definitionCN: 没有困难或延误
senses.example: The meeting went smoothly.
senses.why: This is the main event sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是主要的事件义项。

senses.title: In a steady way
senses.definition: moving in a steady way without shaking
senses.definitionCN: 以稳定、无晃动的方式移动
senses.example: The train ran smoothly along the track.

senses.why: An even surface gives an even motion.

senses.title: In a flowing way

senses.definitionCN: 以顺畅流动的方式，指说话或写作
senses.example: She speaks English smoothly.
senses.why: Language can be smooth like a surface.
senses.whyCN: 语言可以像表面一样平滑。

normal.en: She speaks English smoothly.

core.en: Motion or progress with no bumps.

items.example: A smooth-talking guide sold us the tour.

items.example: The smooth-faced actor played a young king.
items.exampleCN: 那位面容光洁的演员扮演年轻国王。

definition_zh: 蛇；蜿蜒前行；阴险的人
definition_en: a long thin animal with no legs, to move in curves, or a person who cannot be trusted
core_image: 一条长蛇在草丛里蜿蜒滑行
scene: 一条蛇滑过草丛。A snake slid through the grass.
sceneCN: 这里 snake 是「蛇」（第 1 个义项）；句意：一条蛇滑过草丛。

senses.title: Long legless animal
senses.definition: a long thin animal with no legs that moves by sliding
senses.definitionCN: 一种细长无腿、靠滑行移动的动物
senses.example: A snake slid through the grass.
senses.why: This is the animal sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是动物义项。

senses.title: Move in curves
senses.definition: to move in long curves like a snake
senses.definitionCN: 像蛇一样沿长长的曲线移动
senses.example: The road snakes along the coast.

senses.title: Untrustworthy person
senses.definition: a person who is dangerous and cannot be trusted
senses.definitionCN: 危险且不可信任的人
senses.example: He turned out to be a snake.
senses.why: The animal's image carries a warning.
senses.whyCN: 这种动物的形象带有警示意味。

intro.en: Snake comes from an Old English word for the animal.

items.en: The verb meant to move in curves.

items.cn: 这个词也能形容虚伪的人。

items.en: The verb meant to wash with soap.

note.en: Soap is compared with look-alike words and words for cleaning products.
note.cn: 把 soap 与形近词以及表示清洁用品的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Soap turns water into foam and dirt into something that rinses away.
normalIntro.cn: 肥皂让水变成泡沫，让污垢被冲走。

normal.en: Use soap before you wash your hands.
He soaped the car before rinsing it.
normal.cn: 他冲洗前先给车打上肥皂。

normal.en: My grandmother watches a soap every evening.
normal.cn: 我奶奶每晚都看一部肥皂剧。

normal.en: There is a bar of soap by the sink.
Wash the cut with soap and water.

abstract.en: Soap works by letting go of dirt.
abstract.cn: 肥皂的作用在于让污垢松手。

abstract.en: A daily habit can clean more than a rare effort.
abstract.cn: 日常的习惯比偶尔的努力更能保持清洁。

abstract.en: Small bubbles carry away large marks.
abstract.cn: 小小的泡沫带走大大的污痕。

examples.en: Use soap before you wash your hands.
He soaped the car before rinsing it.
examples.cn: 他冲洗前先给车打上肥皂。

examples.en: There is a bar of soap by the sink.

dict_mnemonic.text: soap 与 soup、soak 形近；a bar of soap 是「一块肥皂」，soap opera 是「肥皂剧」。

root: 由古英语 sape（肥皂）演变而来，核心义「与水合用去污的物质」。

sensesIntro.en: Soap is a cleaning substance, the act of washing with it, or a continuing TV drama.
sensesIntro.cn: soap 指清洁物质、用肥皂洗的动作，或电视连续剧。

core.en: A substance that helps water carry dirt away.
core.cn: 帮助水带走污垢的物质。

branches.en: A bar waits by the sink.
Hands rub foam onto a car.
A nightly drama borrows the name.
branches.cn: 每晚播出的剧借用了这个名字。

branches.en: The substance and the washing belong together.
branches.cn: 物质与洗涤动作彼此相属。

branches.en: The same word cleans and entertains.
branches.cn: 同一个词既清洁又娱乐。

intro.en: Soap builds words for washing and for a kind of drama.
intro.cn: soap 构成表示洗涤和一类剧集的词。

latinIntro.en: Soap is a native English word, not Latin.
latinIntro.cn: soap 是英语本族词，不是拉丁语。

items.example: The soap smells of lemon.
She never misses her soaps.
items.exampleCN: 她从不错过她的肥皂剧。

items.example: He soaped his hands carefully.
items.exampleCN: 他仔细地用肥皂洗了手。

items.example: She was soaping the cloth.

items.meaning: like soap or full of foam
items.example: The floor was soapy and unsafe.
The soap opera has run for years.
items.exampleCN: 这部肥皂剧已经播了很多年。

items.example: The soap dish was full of water.
He stood on a soapbox and spoke.
